BOND_DURATION_BLOCKS().notice: Blocks a bond stays live. ~15 minutes at 12s blocks, allowing SGX proof generation to finish before collection expires.

bondAttempt().notice: Bond attempts made against this escrow, starting at 1. A replay tag, spec 10.2. It enters the statement hash, so a proof generated under one lease cannot be presented under a later one. Unlike the rest of the bond state it survives expiry, which is what makes an expired lease's proofs permanently unusable. Fixed-window ZK requests never replace a collector while its redemption claim remains live.

cancelAndWithdraw().notice: Cancel and withdraw funds in a single transaction. Reverts if a node has already bonded.

executionDeadline().notice: Last authenticated payment block for a fixed-window ZK request. Legacy plaintext escrows retain their original collection-lease meaning. A block number rather than a timestamp. Spec 12.7 requires it: the circuit reads the settlement block number from an authenticated header and asserts `bondStartBlock < txBlockNumber <= bondDeadline`, and it cannot compare an authenticated block number against a timestamp.

gasAdvanceClaimed().notice: Whether this funding cycle has already advanced reward funds.

maxGasAdvance().notice: Quote-time reward budget reserved for fresh-EOA gas provisioning.

remainingGasAdvance().notice: Remaining one-time advance available from the existing reward.
